title: ESLint Rule That Enforces Architecture for AI Agents
description:
Your AI agent keeps breaking your architecture? One lint rule stops it. 🧱

✅ Add no-restricted-imports to eslint.config.js
✅ Ban db imports inside your src/ui folder
✅ Run npx eslint and the violation is caught

Day 3 of Agent Harness. Next up: Day 4, Write Error Messages Agents Can Fix.
Follow for a new short every day and build AI agents you can trust.

#shorts #aitools #coding #programming #aicoding #aiagents #eslint #javascript
comment: Lint rule or code review: which catches more? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: add a message to each restricted pattern so the error tells the agent exactly what to do instead.
